';const HB={left:102.59998778299271,right:102.62197813494089,top:3.350013853662471,bottom:3.32702419609485};
function installHD(){try{const d=f.contentDocument,w=f.contentWindow,stage=d.getElementById('stage'),baseImg=d.getElementById('estateImg');if(!stage||!baseImg||!w.screenXY)throw Error('base');let h=d.getElementById('hdSettlement');if(!h){h=d.createElement('img');h.id='hdSettlement';h.alt='HD Penempatan FELDA';h.src=HD;h.style.cssText='position:absolute;pointer-events:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-drag:none;z-index:2;display:none;filter:contrast(1.14) saturate(1.02)';stage.insertBefore(h,d.getElementById('routeSvg'));}
const pos=()=>{if(!h.naturalWidth)return;const tl=w.screenXY(HB.top,HB.left),br=w.screenXY(HB.bottom,HB.right);h.style.left=tl.x+'px';h.style.top=tl.y+'px';h.style.width=(br.x-tl.x)+'px';h.style.height=(br.y-tl.y)+'px';const shown=baseImg.style.display!=='none';h.style.display=shown?'block':'none';h.style.opacity=baseImg.style.opacity||'.84';};
const old=w.renderMap;if(old&&!old.__hd){const wrapped=function(){old();pos()};wrapped.__hd=1;w.renderMap=wrapped;}h.onload=()=>{pos();badge.textContent='GeoPDF HD Penempatan v6.2';const st=d.getElementById('status'),inf=d.getElementById('info');if(st)st.textContent='Hybrid HD v6.2 aktif.';if(inf)inf.textContent='Overlay FELDA HD pada kawasan penempatan + OSM. Peta penuh v5.9 kekal.';};setInterval(pos,120);pos();}catch(e){badge.textContent='HD gagal — v5.9 kekal'}}
f.addEventListener('load',()=>setTimeout(installHD,120));
function openOps(){try{f.contentWindow.openOps()}catch(e){}}function closeOps(){try{f.contentWindow.closeOps()}catch(e){}}function locateMe(){try{f.contentWindow.locateMe()}catch(e){}}function routeTo(k){try{f.contentWindow.routeTo(k)}catch(e){}}function setMapMode(m){try{f.contentWindow.setMapMode(m)}catch(e){}}function setFocus(m){try{f.contentWindow.setFocus(m)}catch(e){}}
</script></body></html>
